query: For my 43-year-old female inpatient with T2D and heart failure, among females 38–48 with both diagnoses, report percentages initiated on insulin versus oral agents in first vs final 72h only.
final_sql: SELECT CAST(insulin_start.insulin_start_count AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(insulin_end.insulin_end_count, 0) AS insulin_ratio, CAST(oral_start.oral_start_count AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(oral_end.oral_end_count, 0) AS oral_ratio FROM admissions admission JOIN insulin_start ON admission.subject_id = insulin_start.subject_id JOIN insulin_end ON admission.subject_id = insulin_end.subject_id JOIN oral_start ON admission.subject_id = oral_start.subject_id JOIN oral_end ON admission.subject_id = oral_end.subject_id WHERE admission.subject_id = 1 AND admission.gender = 'Female' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, admission.dob)) = 43 AND admission.had_icd_code('250.0') AND admission.had_icd_code('254.0');
